identityTest.stableIdentity: A reusable analysis method persists across studies and owns a governed estimator, assumptions, admissible inputs and known failure modes.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Estimator, formula, assumptions, admissible-input contract or failure-mode changes create immutable method revisions.

owns: known failure modes and validity conditions

references.purpose: Studies pinning and applying a method revision

invariants: Method definition and method execution remain distinct.
Every study application pins one immutable method revision.
Study-owned parameters, software, environment and deviations never become method-definition facts.
Definition changes never retroactively alter issued studies.
Study, method, observation, finding, report, recommendation and decision remain distinct identities.
Every finding pins study, method, population or sample and data snapshot versions.
Assumptions and observations remain structurally distinct.
Causal claims require measurand, comparator, design and competing-explanation analysis.
Alternative interpretations coexist as conflict-linked claims.
Reports never substitute for finding justification.
Corrections create successor method revisions and studies.
Retired method identifiers and revisions remain resolvable and are never recycled.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Deontic recommendation specialization and relation contracts remain incomplete.
Frozen audit, source pins, crosswalks and fixtures remain pending.
